before: SELECT l.id FROM sale_lines l LEFT JOIN financial_events f ON f.sale_line_id=l.id WHERE f.id IS NULL OR f.kind<>'SALE' OR f.revenue_delta_m<>l.charged_m OR f.cogs_delta_m<>l.cogs_m OR f.valuation_delta_m<>0 OR f.effective_date<>(SELECT business_date FROM sales WHERE id=l.invoice_id) OR f.recorded_at_ms<>(SELECT recorded_at_ms FROM sales WHERE id=l.invoice_id) LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id FROM cash_flow_evidence e WHERE e.admission_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM counter_cash_admission_resolutions r WHERE r.admission_id=e.admission_id AND r.outcome='POSTED') LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id FROM cash_flow_evidence e LEFT JOIN cash_flow_evidence p ON p.id=e.previous_id WHERE (e.previous_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.id IS NULL OR p.movement_id<>e.movement_id OR p.rowid>=e.rowid)) OR (e.previous_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cash_flow_evidence x WHERE x.movement_id=e.movement_id AND x.previous_id IS NULL AND x.rowid<e.rowid)) LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id FROM counter_cash_admission_resolutions r JOIN counter_cash_admissions a ON a.id=r.admission_id LEFT JOIN cash_action_operations o ON o.id=r.recovery_operation_id LEFT JOIN cash_action_requests q ON q.id=o.request_id LEFT JOIN sale_operations s ON s.id=r.sale_operation_id WHERE (a.source_kind='SALE' AND r.actor_id='ADMIN' AND r.outcome='POSTED' AND r.recovery_operation_id IS NULL) OR (r.recovery_operation_id IS NOT NULL AND (a.source_kind<>'SALE' OR o.id IS NULL OR q.action<>'RESOLVE_ADMISSION' OR json_extract(q.payload_json,'$.resolution') IS NOT 'RECORD_PRIOR_SALE' OR json_extract(q.payload_json,'$.admissionId') IS NOT a.id OR json_extract(o.result_json,'$.invoiceId') IS NOT s.invoice_id)) LIMIT 1
